ITEM 1 | White, fluffy, separated grains with slight moisture and matte sheen, forming a loose mound about 10 cm long and 5 cm wide on the left side of the plate, grains individually distinct with some small scattered loose bits at its edge | 130
ITEM 2 | Pale pinkish-beige chunky pieces in a creamy, glossy sauce with flaky texture, roughly 5 cm by 4 cm cluster, sitting on and beside a few dark green leaves with ruffled edges | 90
ITEM 3 | Dark green leaves, ruffled and flat, a few scattered pieces about 6 cm long total, lying beneath and around the pale chunky piece and near the fries | 10
ITEM 4 | Golden-brown, crisp-looking fried potato pieces with ridged, fluted edges and slightly darker browned tips, about 8 to 10 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, arranged in a loose cluster on the right side of the plate | 120
ITEM 5 | Dark brown, slightly glossy, compact pieces with a seared, browned surface, roughly 3 cm by 2.5 cm, sitting among the fried potato pieces on the right | 25
ITEM 6 | Small amount of brown, glossy sauce or seasoning residue coating the fried potato pieces and plate in a thin layer near the cluster on the right | 5
